question_en: Return CR density (CRs per section) for each spec (change-intensity metric).

semantic_evidence.finding: The answer must associate each returned specification with the numeric density; specNumber and density are both mandatory. An ID-only list would lose the explicitly requested ratio. crCnt/secCnt are transparent intermediate operands in the original RETURN, checked in the native/SQL reference, but the English does not request them as additional fields. Density has number type and exact saved decimal value; no tolerance or integer-only coercion is introduced.
query_clauses: RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber, crCnt, secCnt, round(1.0 * crCnt / secCnt, 2) AS density

semantic_evidence.finding: The Phase3 graph-relative integrated-analysis example asks this same documentary metric. Original design explicitly names Section sources as styled TS document headings (Heading1–5, defensive6/7, Annex8), with lexical identity generation, and release-final Spec instances. Latest-rk selection is the exact authored instance in this release-aware source context. Actual original-styled identity replay across all23 latest DOCX equals all4017 frozen denominator identities. This supports the recorded Section-inventory metric, not an externally complete count of all physical clauses, a normalized cross-release rate, or proof of normative change impact. The broad Clause synonym and two real outline-only headings are explicit counterauthority, addressed below rather than hidden.

Use the original CR-labelled MODIFIES-to-abstract-Spec relationship for the numerator and latest retained edition incoming BELONGS_TO_SPEC Section paths for the denominator. No approval, meeting, author, company, reason/body, or CR-release filter is requested. MODIFIES is a recorded requested-target relationship, not proof every CR was accepted. Exact inner MATCH excludes94 of117 positive hubs without retained release editions;23 release-linked positive hubs yield23 nonempty latest inventories. The question is not silently completed with zero/undefined rows.

The numerator counts CR relationship paths before edition expansion, and the denominator counts Section membership paths after one latest edition is selected. Fresh SQL finds19537 paths across117 positive hubs; within every hub path count equals distinct CR-node count and distinct tdocNumber count, and every counted CR also has Tdoc role. All23 denominator path counts equal distinct node/Section-ID counts. Every retained latest release has a unique maximum edition, so collect[0] has no actual tie ambiguity. The original round(...,2) is retained. These are recorded document/path counts, not a count of unique CR-number families or approved revisions.

WITH hub, crCnt, count(s) AS secCnt
